context: Inventory every retained Makefile and make/ recipe referencing _project on a curated tree, classify each as relocate or explicit-unsupported, implement, extend the curated-release test to execute retained quality targets rather than only collecting them, then remove scripts/check_complexity.py.
description: From the 2026-08-09 adversarial review of PR #1644, deferred at merge without a tracker record. scripts/check_complexity.py (526 lines) is tracked with zero callers after the live checker moved to _project/scripts/check_complexity.py, and it still parses the exclude_functions/exclude_modules pyproject keys that PR #1644 deleted, forming a divergent second authority over the same policy table. Separately, release curation removes _project entirely while retained targets still reference it: complexity-check, complexity-report, and quality-governance-typecheck (Makefile 375-385) run or type-check _project/scripts/check_complexity.py, and release-retained make/ fragments reference _project scripts too (make/documentation.mk platform-manifest targets, make/platform-tests.mk mocker parity, make/worktree-maintenance.mk blind-spot tooling). All of these break on a curated release tree; PR #1644's curation reproduction only exercised help and inventory so it did not catch broken recipes. Decide the release posture per target: relocate needed tooling into release-retained make/ (precedent: make/check_makefile_inventory.py) or make the target fail with an explicit development-tree-only message, then delete the dead duplicate.

anti_patterns.dont: Keep two checker implementations to satisfy both trees.
anti_patterns.instead: One implementation in one release-decided location; every other surface is derived or removed.
anti_patterns.why: Divergent authorities over the same policy caused this defect.

anti_patterns.dont: Resurrect the deleted exclude_functions/exclude_modules keys for compatibility.
anti_patterns.instead: Delete the stale-key consumer together with the duplicate.
anti_patterns.why: The measured no-exception policy is the current authority.

anti_patterns.dont: Verify curated releases by collecting targets without executing them.
anti_patterns.instead: Execute each retained quality target in the curated-release reproduction test.
anti_patterns.why: PR #1644's curation proof ran help and inventory only and missed broken recipes.

preserves.behavior: Development-tree behavior of complexity-check, complexity-report, and quality-governance-typecheck is unchanged.
Public make target names remain available under the same names.
Release curation continues to remove development-only _project content.
The complexity hard ceiling and measured no-exception policy are not weakened.

prior_art.concept: Completed measured complexity policy this item keeps authoritative.

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit/scripts/test_check_release_curation.py tests/unit/scripts/test_check_makefile_inventory.py -q -n 0 && printf "curated runtime tests passed\\n"

work_units.evidence: Inventory found 36 executable retained targets across Makefile and make/*.mk that reference _project. All are development-governance, repository-maintenance, release-cut, PR-administration, or generated-evidence targets; none provides package runtime behavior. Classified all explicit-unsupported on curated releases. help prose and passive spellcheck pathspecs are not executable dependencies.
work_units.summary: Inventory every retained Makefile and make/ recipe that references _project on a curated tree and classify relocate versus explicit-unsupported with rationale

work_units.evidence: A single DEVELOPMENT_TREE_ONLY_TARGETS policy adds a retained prerequisite that succeeds without changing development behavior and fails curated targets with an explicit _project intentionally absent message. Inventory tooling expands the governed target variable and regenerated make/inventory.json reports 188 targets, 184 public, default=test.
work_units.summary: Implement relocations and explicit-unsupported messages per the w0 classification without changing development-tree behavior

work_units.evidence: Deleted the 257-line scripts/check_complexity.py duplicate. Make complexity-check still executes authoritative _project/scripts/check_complexity.py and passes with zero hard failures.
work_units.summary: Delete scripts/check_complexity.py and prove nothing references it

work_units.evidence: Curated runtime tests execute complexity-check, platform-manifest-check, and blind-spots-list and assert the explicit policy error. Static inventory test covers every executable _project recipe; appending an undeclared broken target is the negative control and produces the exact missing-declaration finding. 42 combined focused tests pass.
work_units.summary: Extend the curated-release test to execute retained quality targets, then restore one broken reference as a negative control and prove the test fails
